title: 第46章 《壮志凌云》

第46章 《壮志凌云》-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

10月23日，协和医学院的壹号礼堂内，燕京喜欢文学的青年学子齐聚一堂。
医学院的壹号礼堂历史悠久，1924年，鲁迅、林徽因、梅兰芳，当然还有被鲁迅骂为“日本军师”的胡适等一起聚集在这里，为访问中国的泰戈尔举办了生日宴会。
1925年，国父中山先生逝世后，灵柩曾停放在这里。
如今的壹号礼堂，仍然是协和和中国医学科学院举办聚会的重要场所。
壹号礼堂能容纳四百人左右，可是涌进来的超过了五百人。
要不是刘济民是主角，他说不定根本挤不进来。刘济民在前面走，朱霖、楚红、杨波等人跟在后面。
楚红嘀咕道，今天可终于知道什么叫狐假虎威了。
燕大文学社和医学院文学社的社长、副社长依次上台发言，不过台下闹哄哄的，根本没几人听。
“下面，有请刘济民同志上台讲一讲。刘济民同志在《光明日报》《中国青年杂志》上的文章，对青年人生观的讨论和引导起到了很大的作用。此外，他的小说，想必大家也都看过，让他给我们讲一讲。”陈健功笑着说道。
刘济民在掌声中走上讲台，笑着跟大家打了一个招呼：“欢迎大家来到医学科学院，我是东道主，我代表医学科学院欢迎大家的到来。”
台下的掌声响起，有外校的学生捂着嘴巴窃窃私语，笑着对同伴说“刘济民同志长得可真精神！”
“我是年轻人，在《光明日报》上发表文章，是因为我确实遇到了此类的困惑，我相信大家也有。
我在《中国青年》杂志的采访里说，人生是一个宏大的课题，迷茫时常伴随每一个人生阶段。我相信此时不仅青年人会感到迷茫，国家和社会也同样如此。
但我们不能一直迷茫下去，路漫漫兮探索无疆，只有前行才能找到人生的答案。我认为，无论是工农兵大学生还是高考生，我们都是国家前进的力量。
我们要以国家为后盾，学识为基石，勇敢做时代的先锋。
星光不负赶路人，江河眷顾奋楫者。青年人不能迷茫下去，因为我们是国家的希望。
正因如此，才有了《中国青年》杂志里的时代之问，我希望现场的所有人与我一起，全国的年轻人与我们一起，用我们的双手建设祖国，尽早实现四化。”
现场的掌声如浪潮般一浪高过一浪，这几届考上来的学生绝对是有报国理想的，当然不耽误他们后来选择出国不归，毕竟上了几年大学，心思活了。
人走了太久，都忘了为什么出发。资本主义世界迷人眼，坚守初心难又难。
刘济民接下来给大家介绍了自己的创作经验，写作要结合自身经历：“小说虽然可以有艺术加工，但我希望在一些地方能够据实创作。”
刘济民说完，就走下了台。接下来又有几个小作家上台分享经验，或者朗诵诗歌。
刘济民在台下也没闲着，四周传来一个个本子，纷纷要刘济民签字。
“刘济民同志，你擅长小说创作，不知道你擅不擅长诗歌？当然了，不擅长也没关系，尺有所长，寸有所短嘛！”查建瑛站在台上，刚朗诵完自己写的诗歌，就盯上了台下签字签到手疼的刘济民。

On October 23, young students from Yanjing who loved literature gathered together in Auditorium No. 1 of the Union Medical College.
Auditorium No. 1 of the Medical College has a long history. In 1924, Lu Xun, Lin Huiyin, Mei Lanfang, and of course Hu Shi, who was scolded by Lu Xun as the "Japanese military adviser", gathered here to hold a birthday party for Rabindranath Tagore who visited China.
In 1925, after the death of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the founding father of the country, his coffin was placed here.
Today, Auditorium No. 1 is still an important place for gatherings held by Union Medical College and the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences.
Auditorium No. 1 can accommodate about four hundred people, but more than five hundred people poured in.
If Liu Jimin hadn't been the protagonist, he might not have been able to squeeze in at all. Liu Jimin walked in front, followed by Zhu Lin, Chu Hong, Yang Bo and others.
Chu Hong murmured, today I finally know what the power of a fox and a tiger is.
The presidents and vice-presidents of the Yanda Literary Club and the Medical College Literary Club took the stage to speak one after another, but the audience was so noisy that few people listened.
"Now, I would like to invite Comrade Liu Jimin to speak on stage. Comrade Liu Jimin's articles in Guangming Daily and China Youth Magazine have played a great role in discussing and guiding young people's outlook on life. In addition, everyone must have read his novels. Let him tell us about it." Chen Jiangong said with a smile.
Liu Jimin walked up to the podium amidst applause and greeted everyone with a smile: "Welcome to the Academy of Medical Sciences. I am the host. On behalf of the Academy of Medical Sciences, I welcome everyone."
There was applause from the audience, and some students from other schools covered their mouths and whispered, smiling and saying to their companions, "Comrade Liu Jimin looks really energetic!"
"I am a young man and published an article in Guangming Daily because I have indeed encountered this kind of confusion, and I believe everyone has too.
I said in an interview with China Youth magazine that life is a grand subject, and confusion often accompanies every stage of life. I believe that not only young people will feel confused at this time, but also the country and society.
But we cannot remain confused. The road is long and endless, and only by moving forward can we find the answer to life. I believe that whether we are workers, peasants, soldiers, college students or college entrance examination candidates, we are the force for the advancement of the country.
We must take the country as our backing, knowledge as our cornerstone, and bravely be the vanguard of the times.
The starlight does not disappoint those who are on the road, and the rivers favor those who work hard. Young people cannot remain confused, because we are the hope of the country.
Because of this, there are questions of the times in the "China Youth" magazine. I hope that everyone at the scene will join me and young people across the country will join us to build the motherland with our hands and realize the four modernizations as soon as possible. "
The applause at the scene was like a wave. The students who passed the exam in these years definitely have the ideal of serving the country. Of course, it did not delay their choice to go abroad or not return. After all, they went to college for a few years and their minds were alive.
People have been walking for so long that they forget why they set out. The capitalist world is fascinating, and it is difficult to stick to our original aspirations.
Liu Jimin then introduced his creative experience to everyone. Writing should be based on his own experience: "Although novels can be artistically processed, I hope that in some places, they can be created based on facts."
After Liu Jimin finished speaking, he walked off the stage. Then several young writers came on stage to share their experiences or recite poetry.
Liu Jimin was not idle in the audience either. Notes came from all around, asking for Liu Jimin's signature.
"Comrade Liu Jimin, you are good at writing novels. I wonder if you are good at poetry? Of course, it doesn't matter if you are not good at it. A ruler is strong and an inch is short!" Zha Jianying stood on the stage. As soon as she finished reciting the poem she had written, she stared at Liu Jimin, who was signing and signing in the audience with pain in his hand.
